bullets: US markets shut for Thanksgiving; S&P/Nasdaq futures up ~0.7-1.1% as Asia tech rebounds (Nikkei +1.6%, Hang Seng +2.1%) after this week's AI-led selloff.
VIX still near 28 after S&P flagged a possible Nvidia credit-rating cut on governance risk, keeping a risk-off undertone despite the overnight bounce.
US proposed new tariffs on 14 trading partners including China and the EU, adding fresh trade-policy uncertainty into year-end.
European indices closed lower Wednesday (FTSE -0.4%, DAX -1.3%, CAC -0.8%); Brent +0.6%, gold +1.6%, 10Y yield eased to 4.85%.

BJ.why: BJ's beat Q3 and raised FY26 guidance, but results leaned on a $240M one-time legal settlement masking margin pressure; insider selling flagged and BofA cut to Neutral (company-specific), explaining the drop.
BJ.bull: Raised guidance and record membership base suggest the core business is still growing.
BJ.bear: One-time settlement masks margin pressure; insider selling is a genuine earnings-quality red flag.

sources.title: What Does BJ's Wholesale Club Holdings (BJ) Raised Guidance Mean After Q3?

WST.why: WST beat Q3 (EPS +35.7%) and raised FY26 outlook to $9.38-9.48 EPS; no negative company news found. Decline looks like profit-taking on an overbought name amid the broader multi-day risk-off tape.
WST.bull: Raised guidance, 35.7% EPS growth, and 15 buy vs 1 sell rating show momentum intact.
WST.bear: Stock was overbought into earnings; pullback could extend if broad risk-off persists.

sources.title: West Pharmaceutical: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors

TXN.why: Weakness tracks a sector-wide semiconductor oversupply scare (UBS flagged rising chip inventories industry-wide), not a TXN problem; Cantor Fitzgerald upgraded TXN to Overweight and raised PT to 385 this week.
TXN.bull: Diversified industrial/auto/data-center mix and a fresh Overweight upgrade argue TXN is relatively insulated.
TXN.bear: If chip oversupply shows up in numbers next quarter, the whole group re-rates lower.

sources.title: Texas Instruments (TXN) Remains A Preferred Pick Despite Chip Oversupply Risk

ASH.why: Ashland is in confirmed, unresolved takeover talks with Clariant/CD&R (all-cash, near current price); Bloomberg says a deal 'could come together in coming days' but could also fall through, a binary event risk inside the hold window.
ASH.bull: An all-cash buyout near the current price would cap downside and could close within days.
ASH.bear: No certainty talks conclude; a collapsed deal would remove the takeover premium fast.
ASH.catalysts: Possible Clariant/CD&R deal announcement or collapse

J.why: Reporting explicitly states 'no company news explained the drop'; Jacobs fell with engineering/construction peers (Quanta, Comfort Systems) in a broad AI-led Nasdaq selloff. Truist, UBS and RBC all raised price targets this week.
J.bull: Peers fell in lockstep and three analysts raised price targets this week; no company damage.
J.bear: Still exposed to further broad risk-off if the AI-led selloff resumes.

sources.title: Jacobs (J) Stock Is Down 5.7% Today: AI-Led Market Selloff

MPC.why: Decline tracks a 7th-straight-day drop across refiners (Marathon, Valero, Phillips 66) as the 3-2-1 crack spread nearly halved from its October peak amid easing Middle East supply-risk premium; no company-specific news found.
MPC.bull: US gasoline demand at record highs and restricted new refining capacity support margins longer-term.
MPC.bear: Crack spreads could keep compressing further if geopolitical risk premium keeps unwinding.
